instruction: Search for the name Olivia on BabyCenter and find names similar to it.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated from babycenter.com/child to Baby Names section, searched for 'Carl', found the details page at babycenter.com/baby-names/details/carl-853, and scrolled to the similar names section. Handled privacy dialog and signup popup along the way.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can handle privacy dialogs and popups, navigate babycenter.com navigation menu, use the baby name search feature, scroll through page content to find specific sections
metadata.task_rationale: Closest to the original task - find similar names to a different name (Olivia instead of Carl). Tests same workflow but with a different target, requiring the model to navigate to the details page which contains the similar names section.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from babycenter.com/child to the baby names section, searching for 'Olivia', and reaching the Olivia details page (which contains similar names). Evaluator checks that the active URL matches the babycenter baby name details page for Olivia using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL, which is the right state for verifying navigation to the Olivia details page.

Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) uses re.search with the pattern 'babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/olivia', which will correctly match URLs with ID suffixes (e.g., olivia-3346) since re.search finds partial matches.
Metric parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' causes framework to pass rules dict directly, and metric accesses rules['expected'] correctly.

Minor coverage gap: instruction asks to 'find names similar to it' but evaluator only verifies the URL of the details page, not that similar names are actually visible. However, the details page inherently contains the similar names section, making this a reasonable proxy.
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL, metric accepts string or dict with 'url' field.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: For stricter verification, consider adding a second evaluator step that checks the page content for the presence of a 'Similar Names' section, rather than relying solely on the URL as a proxy.
